title: options: for the Git sparse checkout material
description: The options: block of a pipelines-as-code material declared with plugin_configuration.id com.github.palencharj.gocd.git-sparse-material (version "1"). Every value is a flat string. Generated from ScmProperty; do not edit by hand.

branch.description: Branch to poll and check out. Defaults to master.

sparse_paths.description: Paths to check out, one gitignore-style pattern per line. In YAML use a literal block (|), not a folded one (>): a folded block joins the lines into one pattern.

username.description: HTTP(S) username. Leave out for SSH keys.

password.description: HTTP(S) password or token. In a config repo use a secret reference such as {{SECRET:[store][key]}} under options: (not secure_options:).

shallow.description: Fetch only the tip commit; deepens automatically when a build needs an older revision.

filter_by_paths.description: Poll only commits that touch the sparse paths, so a pipeline builds only when its own code changes.

partial_clone.description: Clone the agent's working copy with --filter=blob:none so file contents are fetched only for the checked-out paths. Applies on the next clone.
